content.name: LI Freight Distribution Network (FDN)
content.author: Logain Abler
content.description: BETA logistics mod for X4: Foundations 9.00. Designate player stations as Distribution Centres, supply production from DC stock, return surplus and collect overstock, with fees and a read-only Overview. Requires SirNukes Mod Support APIs (Workshop 2042901274). Similar in idea to Logain Industries FDN for X3 - a new mod, not a port.
